narrative.details:
It seems as though poor Ol' Rustlocke ran into a Dark Iron ambush.  You notice a parchment next to his clenched fist.

Report the grim news to Rhag Garmason and show him what you found.
narrative.objectives: Report back to Rhag Garmason and show him the parchment you found on Rustlocke's corpse.
narrative.offerRewardText: Oh my, the news is grave....
narrative.requestItemsText: Any sign of Ol' Rustlocke, adventurer?
